title: Sycophancy from mixed rewards
brief: Fit a rater's agreement bias from comparisons, solve the mixed-reward optimum in closed form, find the critical weight w*, and see an aggregate score hide a collapsing slice.
hints: The Newton step for Bradley-Terry is theta + solve(X.T @ W @ X, X.T @ (a_wins - p)), where X = feats_a - feats_b, p = sigmoid(X @ theta), and W = diag(p * (1 - p)).
The optimum is p_ref * exp(r / beta), normalized within each row. Work in logits and subtract each row's maximum before you exponentiate.
On a wrong user, agreeing earns w * b and correcting earns (1 - w) + w * k. Set the gap to -beta * log(p / (1 - p)) and solve for w.
acc_wrong is the probability of the correct reply when the user is wrong, which is policy[1, 1], not policy[1, 0].
